LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SENTENCES: DIRECT AND INDIRECT SPEECH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we report what others have said?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use the correct punctuation marks in direct speech
2. apply direct and indirect speech correctly in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SENTENCES: DIRECT AND INDIRECT SPEECH
This lesson teaches Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. use the correct punctuation marks in direct speech
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply direct and indirect speech correctly in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech above.
2. Explain Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in use 14.3.1 Sentences: Direct and Indirect Speech important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we report what others have said?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use the correct punctuation marks in direct speech
2. apply direct and indirect speech correctly in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
